desc: A stadium or arena erupting - goal, verdict, entrance.
prompt: a large stadium crowd of thousands roaring and cheering all at once, sustained wall of voices, hands clapping through it, open air, distant
negative: music, singing, chanting, announcer, commentary, drums
note: The negative deliberately does NOT contain 'speech' - the house SFX negative would suppress the voices that are the entire point. 'announcer, commentary' are in instead, because crowd prompts reliably pull a PA voice in and one intelligible word ruins the bed. Build the swell in post: this renders at a constant level, it does not crescendo on your cue.
